{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep only the row with the highest sample_seq per patient
# This ensures one row per patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Check: now should be 800 rows (848 - 48 retested rows)
print(f"Number of patients after deduplication: {len(df_dedup)}")

# Apply batch correction: assay_batch B values are in µg/L, need to divide by 10 to convert to ng/mL
# Batch A is already in ng/mL, so no change needed
df_dedup['biomarker_final_corrected'] = df_dedup['biomarker_final']
df_dedup.loc[df_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final_corrected'] /= 10

# Compute the mean of the corrected biomarker_final
mean_biomarker_final = df_dedup['biomarker_final_corrected'].mean()

print(f"Mean biomarker_final (corrected to ng/mL): {mean_biomarker_final}")
print(f"Mean biomarker_final (corrected to ng/mL): {mean_biomarker_final:.2f}")"}
